prompt: Synthesize intelligence-team outputs for AlphaTraderTV into a 9-month strategy. Approve or revise individual agent outputs. Define quarterly themes, content mix, key bets, and escalations needing CEO sign-off before onboarding completes.
raw_output:
The intelligence layer for AlphaTraderTV is coherent and high-confidence. The channel is a tactical-execution options channel with a credible host, mid-tier metrics, and a clear unlock: stop publishing flat, align with market events, double down on monthly-income content with real fills, and build a beginner-funnel playlist that converts subs into long-watch-time loyalists.

The path from 38k to 100k subs in 9 months requires roughly 6,800 net new subs/month — a 4.1x improvement over the current 410/week run-rate. This is achievable if (a) the new thumbnail-template lifts CTR from 2.1% to 3.8% (conservative for this niche cohort), (b) cadence increases from 2 to 2.5 videos/week, and (c) Shorts cadence rises to 4/week using P&L-reveal hook. The math: CTR lift alone raises impressions-to-views by ~81%, compounding with cadence yields ~3.6x at minimum.

Q1 theme: 'Real Monthly Income' — monthly P&L breakdowns, named strikes, iron condor focus. Q2 theme: 'Earnings & Events' — tactical setups around earnings/Fed/OPEX. Q3 theme: 'Beginner-to-Operator Funnel' — playlist-driven evergreen series. Crypto content gets sunset on the main channel; recommend separate sub-brand decision at Q3 review.

Approvals: channel-auditor APPROVED with note to add benchmark cohort table next quarter. brand-voice-specialist APPROVED, no revisions. niche-intelligence-analyst APPROVED. audience-persona-builder APPROVED with note to add secondary persona ('the dabbler') in Q2 if Marcus content saturates. competitor-analyst APPROVED.

Escalations to CEO: (1) crypto sub-brand decision — needs explicit yes/no before Q3; (2) compliance review of 'real P&L' content given likely SEC scrutiny on retail trading content; (3) approval to allocate 15% of production capacity to evergreen series videos with no immediate ROI.

approvals.notes: Add benchmark cohort table next quarter
Monitor 0DTE trend — re-evaluate brand fit Q2
Consider secondary persona Q2 if Marcus saturates

strategy_adjustments.focus: Monthly P&L breakdowns, iron condor specialization
Tactical setups around earnings, Fed, OPEX

strategy_adjustments.rule: Crypto content paused on main channel; sub-brand decision Q3
Every long-form has chapters, mobile-checked thumbnail, keyword in first 40 chars

escalations_to_ceo: Crypto sub-brand: yes/no before Q3 planning
Compliance review on 'real P&L' content (SEC retail-trading guidance)
Approval to allocate 15% production capacity to no-immediate-ROI evergreen series
